## Assessment at a glance

- **Labs (15%)** — best 12 of 14, 1.25% each; graded on passing the notebook's assertion
  checks plus short reflection answers.
- **Homeworks (30%)** — three larger assignments (5–10 h each) mixing derivations and
  implementation, released after weeks 4, 8, and 12.
- **Midterm (15%)** — written, 90 minutes, week 8, covers weeks 1–7. A sample exam with
  solutions is published beforehand.
- **Project (20%)** — teams of 2–3; proposal (Wk 9), midway check (Wk 13), report + code +
  8-minute talk (Wk 15).
- **Final (20%)** — written, 90 minutes, week 15, cumulative with post-midterm emphasis.
  One single-sided A4 cheat sheet and a calculator allowed.

Grade cutoffs: **A ≥ 90 · B ≥ 75 · C ≥ 60**.
